action: Publica members and pension recipients should watch for phishing that uses their personal details and follow Publica's notices. Organisations should check which supplier test environments hold real personal data.
date_note: Date of Publica's announcement; the attack on its supplier was at the end of September 2026.
exec: A supplier's test environment held pension fund members' personal data, a reminder to control real data in non-production systems.
plain: The Swiss federal pension fund Publica says personal data of members may have leaked after its software supplier was hacked. Pensions are safe, and an outside audit has been ordered.

key_findings: Publica's software supplier PK Softech AG suffered a cyber attack at the end of September 2026.
Publica says it must assume personal data of current and former active members and pension recipients leaked from the test environment.
Publica's productive systems were not affected; it says pension assets and pensions are safe.
What data leaked and who is affected is not yet known; the audit ends by the end of January 2027, with a first report by the end of March 2027.

sources.name: admin.ch: Publica to commission external audit

summary: Publica, the Swiss federal pension fund, announced on 19 November that its Board will commission an external audit after a cyber attack on its software supplier PK Softech AG at the end of September 2026. Publica says it must assume personal data of members and pension recipients leaked from a test environment. Its productive systems were not affected, and the scope of the leak is not yet known.
title: Swiss pension fund Publica to audit data handling after cyber attack on supplier PK Softech

validation.note: Official Swiss government press release read in full.
